# FF Converter

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./ff-converter/img/ff-converter.png").default}
  alt={"FF Converter: screenshot 1"}
/>

FF Converter opens Siemens firmware dumps in BIN and FLS formats, detects the
flash memory type, and saves the data as FullFlash in BIN format.
